report.explanation: Alert observations show healthy checkout responses (200s, 63-94ms), and logs/metrics corroborate: /v1/checkout p95 ~98ms, zero 502s, all info-level 200s. No error, latency, saturation, or deployment-caused signal is present. Current evidence does not establish any bounded root cause from the taxonomy, so hand off rather than assert a fault.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency/error SLO for /v1/checkout to judge whether observed durations are anomalous
Downstream dependency latency/error telemetry for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis
Resource saturation metrics (CPU, memory, DB pool) for gateway and downstream services
Error or timeout logs across the request path during the alert window
